title: A Criterion for Covariance in Complex Sequential Growth Models
section_locator: Section2.3 Theorem2.1; Section3.1 Theorem3.1 and Claim3.2/Eq.(22)
assumptions: Compatible complex cylinder charge on the labelled growth event algebra; bounded variation and row-excess bounds for extension. Coupling specializations elsewhere are not assumed here.
